name: ITMAX System Berhad
summary: ITMAX System Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the supply, installation, and provision of public space networked systems in Malaysia. The company offers smart video surveillance, smart parking, smart traffic management, as well as smart street lighting and communication networks. It also engages in the business of green and sustainable technology solutions; and trading and fabrication of information technology products and services.
